name: EA Close
summary: EA Close is a utility expert advisor designed to close all open positions and/or pending orders on the account either immediately or based on configurable conditions such as profit/loss thresholds, magic number, symbol, or time. It does not open any new trades and serves solely as a position/order management tool for risk control and account cleanup.
summary_zh: EA Close是一个工具型EA，用于根据可配置条件（如盈亏阈值、魔术号、品种、时间等）平仓所有持仓和/或删除挂单。它不开放任何新交易，仅作为仓位/订单管理工具用于风险控制和账户清理。
strategy_analysis: EA Close本质上不是一个交易策略EA，而是一个仓位管理工具。它的核心功能是根据用户设定的参数批量关闭持仓或删除挂单。入场条件不适用，因为它不开仓；出场条件包括按总盈利阈值平仓、按总亏损阈值平仓、按单笔盈利/亏损平仓、按魔术号过滤平仓、按品种过滤平仓、按时间定时平仓等。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及建仓逻辑，仅负责平仓操作，可以设置是平多头、空头还是全部平仓。资金管理方面，通过设定盈亏阈值来保护账户资金，防止过度亏损或锁定已获利润。该EA通常作为辅助工具配合其他交易策略EA使用，在达到特定条件时执行一键平仓或条件平仓。
strategy_analysis_en: EA Close is fundamentally not a trading strategy EA but rather a position management utility tool. Its core function is to batch-close positions or delete pending orders based on user-configured parameters. Entry conditions are not applicable since it does not open positions; exit conditions include closing by total profit threshold, total loss threshold, per-position profit/loss threshold, magic number filter, symbol filter, time-based scheduled closing, and more. In terms of position management, the EA does not involve position-opening logic and only handles closing operations, with options to close long positions, short positions, or all positions. For money management, it protects account equity by setting profit/loss thresholds to prevent excessive drawdown or lock in realized profits. The EA is typically used as a supplementary tool alongside other trading strategy EAs, executing one-click or conditional closing when specific criteria are met.

parameters.name: CloseProfit
parameters.description: 总盈利达到该值时平仓(0=不启用)
parameters.description_en: Close all when total profit reaches this value (0=disabled)

parameters.name: CloseLoss
parameters.description: 总亏损达到该值时平仓(0=不启用)
parameters.description_en: Close all when total loss reaches this value (0=disabled)

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Close orders with specified magic number (-1=all)

pros: 操作简单直观，可一键批量平仓，提高执行效率
支持多种过滤条件（魔术号、品种、方向），灵活控制平仓范围
盈亏阈值平仓功能可有效保护账户资金，锁定利润或限制亏损
作为辅助工具可与任何交易策略EA配合使用，兼容性强
可设置定时平仓，适用于时段交易或重大事件前自动清仓
pros_en: Simple and intuitive operation with one-click batch closing for improved execution efficiency
Supports multiple filter conditions (magic number, symbol, direction) for flexible closing scope control
Profit/loss threshold closing effectively protects account equity by locking profits or limiting drawdown
Highly compatible as a supplementary tool that works with any trading strategy EA
Scheduled closing capability useful for session-based trading or automatic liquidation before major events
cons: 作为工具EA本身不产生交易信号，依赖其他EA或手动交易才有意义
批量平仓在市场剧烈波动时可能因滑点导致实际成交价偏离预期
缺乏高级风控功能如分批平仓或追踪止损，功能相对单一
频繁轮询检查条件可能增加服务器负担，尤其在持仓数量多时
部分参数默认值可能不适合所有交易环境，需要用户根据实际情况调整
cons_en: As a utility EA it generates no trading signals and is only meaningful when combined with other EAs or manual trading
Batch closing during extreme market volatility may result in slippage causing actual fill prices to deviate from expected levels
Lacks advanced risk management features such as partial closing or trailing stops, making functionality relatively limited
Frequent polling to check conditions may increase server load, especially with large numbers of positions
Some default parameter values may not suit all trading environments and require user adjustment based on actual conditions
improvements: 增加分批平仓功能，允许按比例逐步减仓以减少滑点影响
添加图形界面面板，方便用户实时查看持仓状态和一键操作平仓
增加邮件/推送通知功能，在执行平仓操作后通知用户
improvements_en: Add partial closing functionality to allow gradual position reduction by percentage to minimize slippage impact
Add a graphical interface panel for real-time position monitoring and one-click closing operations
Add email/push notification to alert users after closing operations are executed

risk_points: 批量平仓在极端行情下可能因流动性不足导致滑点较大
如果参数设置不当（如盈利阈值过小），可能在未达到最佳获利点时过早平仓
risk_points_en: Batch closing during extreme market conditions may result in significant slippage due to insufficient liquidity
Improper parameter settings (e.g., profit threshold too small) may trigger premature closing before optimal profit levels are reached

summary_en: EA Close is a utility expert advisor designed to close all open positions and/or pending orders on the account either immediately or based on configurable conditions such as profit/loss thresholds, magic number, symbol, or time. It does not open any new trades and serves solely as a position/order management tool for risk control and account cleanup.
